_comment: 'Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack.' Card-level activation_cost 1 and per_turn 1 are DSL-authoritative; play._add_weapon_attacks offers the attack for a weapon with printed power + activation_cost while per-turn activations remain. The ACTIVATE ability carrying an ATTACK effect follows the shipped weapon precedents (cintari_saber draft, cru/sledge_of_anvilheim, dyn/merciless_battleaxe) - it declares the ability rather than creating a second attack path. Spellvoid 1 is a printed keyword -> card DB keywords field, deliberately NOT authored here.
